segs.pali: (17) 7. Kammapathapeyyālaṃ
segs.zh: （十七）第七 业道略

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi , bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi tīhi? Attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti, parañca pāṇātipāte samādapeti, pāṇātipāte ca samanuñño hoti. Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者，如其所带，必堕地狱。哪三法？自己杀生，又劝导他人杀生，且赞许杀生。诸比丘，具足此三法者，如其所带，必堕地狱。

segs.pali: ‘‘Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi tīhi? Attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足三法者，如其所携而被放置于天界。哪三法？自己远离杀生，也劝导他人远离杀生，并赞许远离杀生。……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca adinnādāyī hoti, parañca adinnādāne samādapeti, adinnādāne ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己是偷盗者，也劝导他人是偷盗者，且赞许是偷盗者……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, parañca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, adinnādānā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己远离不与取，也劝导他人远离不与取，并随喜远离不与取……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca kāmesumicchācārī hoti, parañca kāmesumicchācāre samādapeti, kāmesumicchācāre ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己行欲邪行，也劝导他人行欲邪行，并随喜欲邪行……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, parañca kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己远离欲邪行，也劝导他人远离欲邪行，并随喜远离欲邪行……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca musāvādī hoti, parañca musāvāde samādapeti, musāvāde ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己是妄语者，又教人是妄语者，且赞同是妄语者……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, parañca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己离妄语，又教人离妄语，且随喜离妄语……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca pisuṇavāco hoti, parañca pisuṇāya vācāya samādapeti, pisuṇāya vācāya ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己两舌，又教人两舌，且赞同两舌……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañca pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己远离两舌，也劝导他人远离两舌，并赞同远离两舌……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca pharusavāco hoti, parañca pharusāya vācāya samādapeti, pharusāya vācāya ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己行粗恶语，也劝导他人行粗恶语，并赞同粗恶语……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañca pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己远离粗恶语，也劝导他人远离粗恶语，并赞同远离粗恶语……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca samphappalāpī hoti, parañca samphappalāpe samādapeti, samphappalāpe ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自身是杂秽语者，并劝导他人行杂秽语，亦赞许杂秽语……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, parañca samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自身远离杂秽语，并劝导他人远离杂秽语，亦赞许远离杂秽语……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca abhijjhālu hoti, parañca abhijjhāya samādapeti, abhijjhāya ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自身是贪求者，并劝导他人行贪求，亦赞许贪求……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca anabhijjhālu hoti, parañca anabhijjhāya samādapeti, anabhijjhāya ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己无有贪求，亦劝导他人不贪求，且随喜不贪求……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca byāpannacitto hoti, parañca byāpāde samādapeti, byāpāde ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己心怀嗔恨，亦劝导他人嗔恨，且随喜嗔恨……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca abyāpannacitto hoti, parañca abyāpāde samādapeti, abyāpāde ca samanuñño hoti….
segs.zh: “自己心无嗔恨，亦劝导他人无嗔恨，且随喜无嗔恨……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, micchādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti ….
segs.zh: “自己持邪见，又劝导他人持邪见，也赞同邪见……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, sammādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti. Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’’ti.
segs.zh: “自己持正见，也劝导他人正见，也赞同正见。诸比丘！具足这三法者，便如其所为，投生天界。”

segs.pali: Kammapathapeyyālaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
segs.zh: 业道略说品终

segs.pali: Tassuddānaṃ –
segs.zh: 其摄颂：

segs.pali: Pāṇaṃ adinnamicchā ca, musāvādī ca pisuṇā;
segs.zh: 杀生、不与取、邪淫，妄语及两舌；

segs.pali: Pharusā samphappalāpo ca, abhijjhā byāpādadiṭṭhi ca;
segs.zh: 粗恶语及绮语，贪欲、嗔恚及邪见。

segs.pali: Kammapathesu peyyālaṃ, tikakena niyojayeti.
segs.zh: 于诸业道，略说即是以三法来统摄。
